espn-604593.headline: Jake White's Fiji debut against Japan in Tokyo
beats: Japan beat Fiji 20-15 in the Pacific Nations Cup final on 19 September, the country's first Pacific Nations Cup title since 2019.
Fiji had the last word in 2025, winning 33-27 in Japan in the Pacific Nations Cup knockout stage on 21 September.
Form favours Japan: three straight wins, and 4 of 8 in 2026. Fiji have won 1 of 5 this year and lost their last game.

Jake White takes charge for his first match after being appointed from 31 applicants to replace interim coach Senirusi Seruvakula. Fiji are preparing in Japan at D-Rocks Rugby Club for what is billed as the "Anniversary Test".
Ranking at stake: Japan are 9th (77.28 points) and Fiji 10th (76.81). Both then travel to face Wales (Japan) and France (Fiji) on 7 November.
